newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen rallying further on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen rallying further on Thursday.

text.p: Soaring Thai stocks, which leapt 7.87 percent on Wednesday after the baht was floated, would likely further their rally on Thursday on expectations of more foreign buying, brokers said.

"I think foreign investors would continue buying tomorrow as they could not buy much today because all large capitalised stocks hit limit up. There are signs that they are waiting to buy big banks such as Bangkok Bank, Thai Farmers and Siam Commercial," said Dusanee Klewpatinontha of Nithipat Capital.
